name: model-strategy
description: Cost-effective model and effort selection for Claude Code. Routes operations through a first-match policy (P0 approval-gate / R0 direct / R1 scout / R2 verify / R3 delegate / R4 main) via scripts/route-policy.mjs, recommends the optimal model (Fable/Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) and effort level per task, and delegates to pre-configured subagents (sonnet-implementer / haiku-scout). Backed by a reference library with official pricing and effort documentation.
